title: TCP/IP Message Header
applicability: Applies to every ATL105 message carrying Segment 100, but defines transport framing rather than Segment 100 business fields.

businessRequirements.title: TCP/IP Message Length is a two-byte length of all following message data excluding the length field itself.
TCP/IP Message Length is transmitted in network byte order with the high-order byte first.
The TPDU Protocol ID is fixed at 0x60.
TPDU destination and source address bytes are zero when sending messages to BUYPASS.

negative: Length excludes or includes wrong bytes

testDataStatus: Existing package coverage is in segment-100-item-01-message-length-package.json and segment-100-item-02-tpdu-header-package.json.
